title: Q-STALL-replication-ledger-beat: clock replication-ledger-beat stopped and restarts did not take
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** clock `replication-ledger-beat` stopped (last beat age None s, expected every 3600 s) and 2 restarts did not take
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation resilience --probe replication-ledger-beat
**Status:** closed

RESILIENCE-1: find why the clock stopped (disabled schedule, failing job, dead route), fix the cause, and add a second independent trigger so it cannot stop silently again. Escalated through the queue, never by email.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation resilience --probe replication-ledger-beat` reports ticking.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
